label: 연회를 사흘 더 이어갑니다
label_en: Extend the feast three more days
success_text_en: The feast became legend and followers multiplied.
fail_text: 쓰러지는 사람이 속출해 연회가 추문으로 끝났습니다.
fail_text_en: People kept collapsing and the feast ended in scandal.

label: 지친 이들을 쉬게 하고 연회를 마칩니다
label_en: Let the exhausted rest and close the feast
success_text: 사람들은 아쉬워했지만 신도들은 당신의 배려를 기억합니다.
success_text_en: People grumbled, but your followers remember your care.

label: 정면으로 받아들여 더 화려한 밤을 엽니다
label_en: Accept and throw an even grander night
success_text_en: Even the queen's devotees crossed over to you.
fail_text: 여왕의 밤이 더 화려했다는 소문이 퍼졌습니다.
fail_text_en: Word spread that the queen's night was more dazzling.

label: 그녀를 교단의 객원으로 초대합니다
label_en: Invite her as a guest of the cult
success_text: 두 세력이 손을 잡자 밤의 도시가 하나가 되었습니다.
success_text_en: With both factions joined, the city of night became one.
fail_text: 그녀가 당신의 신도들 사이에서 세력을 키우기 시작했습니다.
fail_text_en: She began building her own following among your people.

label: 대결을 무시합니다
success_text_en: People whisper that you lost your nerve.

label: 더 강렬한 의식을 내려 줍니다
label_en: Grant them a more intense rite
success_text: 그들은 황홀경 속에서 당신을 신으로 받들었습니다.
success_text_en: In their ecstasy they worshipped you as a god.
fail_text: 의식 중 한 명이 쓰러져 소문이 흉흉해졌습니다.
fail_text_en: One collapsed during the rite and grim rumors spread.

label: 그들을 돌보며 쉬게 합니다
label_en: Tend to them and make them rest
success_text: 당신의 손길에 그들은 겨우 숨을 돌렸습니다.
success_text_en: Under your care they finally caught their breath.

label: 기꺼이 문을 엽니다
success_text_en: The secret held and the temple coffers swelled.
fail_text: 남편 하나가 사실을 알고 신전을 고발했습니다.
fail_text_en: One husband found out and denounced the temple.

label: 남편들까지 함께 초대합니다
success_text: 권력자들이 당신의 연회에 줄을 서게 되었습니다.
success_text_en: Powerful men now queue for your banquets.
fail_text_en: Jealous husbands ended up dueling.

label: 정중히 거절합니다
success_text_en: The wives mocked you as old-fashioned.

label: 그들 앞에 직접 나타나 진짜를 보여 줍니다
label_en: Appear before them and show the real thing
success_text_en: The crowds abandoned the fakes the moment they saw you.
fail_text_en: The long tour left you utterly drained.

label: 가짜들을 교단 지부장으로 임명합니다
label_en: Appoint the fakes as branch leaders
success_text: 흉내쟁이들이 이제 당신의 이름으로 사람을 모읍니다.
success_text_en: The imitators now gather people in your name.
fail_text_en: They twisted the doctrine as they pleased.

label: 무대에 올라 노래합니다
success_text_en: The audience greeted you with a standing ovation.
fail_text_en: Your voice cracked and laughter broke out.

label: 객석에서 조용히 관람합니다
success_text: 신도들은 당신과 함께 작품을 즐기며 하나가 되었습니다.
success_text_en: Your followers enjoyed the work with you as one.

label: 허락합니다
success_text_en: The statue became the city's landmark.
fail_text_en: The council pushed back and restricted cult gatherings.

label: 신전 안뜰에만 두게 합니다
label_en: Keep it in the temple courtyard
success_text_en: Pilgrims visit the temple to see the statue.

label: 경연을 열어 승자를 정합니다
label_en: Hold a contest to pick a winner
success_text_en: The contest paintings became the cult's sacred art.
fail_text_en: The loser's admirers left the cult.

label: 둘 다 후원합니다
success_text_en: The two painters competed to offer masterpieces.

label: 광장에서 시 낭송회를 열어 맞섭니다
label_en: Defy him with a public poetry reading
success_text: 군중이 시인 편에 서자 검열관은 물러났습니다.
success_text_en: With the crowd behind the poets, the censor backed down.
fail_text_en: The guard broke up the reading.

label: 검열관을 연회에 초대해 마음을 녹입니다
label_en: Melt the censor's heart at a banquet
success_text: 검열관은 다음 날 시집의 첫 독자가 되었습니다.
success_text_en: The next day the censor became the book's first reader.
fail_text_en: He loudly cried bribery.

label: 모두 받아들입니다
success_text_en: The temple became noisy but full of life.

label: 작품을 심사해 골라 받습니다
success_text_en: The select few raised the cult's prestige.
fail_text: 떨어진 자들이 교단을 비방하는 노래를 퍼뜨렸습니다.
fail_text_en: The rejected spread songs mocking the cult.

label: 금으로 신전 지붕을 덮습니다
label_en: Gild the temple roof with gold
success_text: 황금 지붕은 멀리서도 보이는 자랑이 되었습니다.
success_text_en: The golden roof became a boast seen from afar.
fail_text: 밤사이 지붕 금박이 통째로 뜯겨 나갔습니다.
fail_text_en: Overnight the gold leaf was stripped clean.

label: 용병을 고용해 곳간을 지킵니다
label_en: Hire mercenaries to guard the vaults
success_text: 곳간 앞에 창이 번뜩이자 도둑들이 사라졌습니다.
success_text_en: With spears gleaming at the vaults, the thieves vanished.

label: 빌려 줍니다
success_text: 배들이 돌아오자 금은 두 배가 되었습니다.
success_text_en: The ships returned and the gold doubled.
fail_text_en: A storm sank the fleet.

label: 거절하고 금을 쌓아 둡니다
success_text_en: The guild called you a cowardly miser.

label: 헌금 순위를 더 공개적으로 만듭니다
label_en: Make the offering ranks even more public
success_text: 부자들이 앞자리를 다투며 헌금을 더 냈습니다.
success_text_en: The rich fought for front seats and gave more.
fail_text_en: Quite a few poor followers left.

label: 하루만 자리를 자유롭게 합니다
label_en: Free the seating for one day
success_text_en: For once the poor prayed in the front rows.

label: 재무관에게 금을 쥐여 줍니다
label_en: Press gold into the treasurer's hand
success_text_en: The figures in the ledger shrank as if by magic.
fail_text: 뇌물이 들통나 세금이 더 무겁게 매겨졌습니다.
fail_text_en: The bribe was exposed and the tax was raised.

label: 장부를 숨기고 버팁니다
label_en: Hide the books and hold out
success_text_en: The treasurer left empty-handed.
fail_text_en: Soldiers stormed in and searched the vaults.

label: 세금을 순순히 냅니다
success_text_en: People laughed that the Golden Cult was naive.

label: 더 큰 배당을 약속합니다
success_text_en: Followers returned to praise your gold.
fail_text_en: The promise strained the vaults.

label: 은빛 손을 통째로 사들입니다
label_en: Buy out the Silver Hand outright
success_text_en: The rival's banner was replaced with gold.
fail_text_en: They took the gold and fled.

label: 본보기로 쫓아냅니다
label_en: Throw him out as an example
success_text: 상회의 몫을 떼먹으면 끝장이라는 소문이 시장에 돌았습니다.
success_text_en: Word spread through the market: skim the house and you are finished.

label: 그의 수법을 상회에 들입니다
label_en: Bring his trick into the trading house
success_text: 그의 교묘한 수법이 상회의 새로운 이윤이 되었습니다.
success_text_en: His clever trick became a new source of profit for the house.
fail_text_en: He cooked the house's books as well and fled.

label: 이자를 올려 더 끌어모읍니다
label_en: Raise rates to draw more in
success_text: 신전 은행은 왕국 제일의 금고가 되었습니다.
success_text_en: The temple bank became the realm's greatest vault.
fail_text: 인출 소동이 벌어져 금고가 크게 흔들렸습니다.
fail_text_en: A bank run shook the vaults badly.

label: 지금 이자를 유지합니다
success_text: 더 높은 이자를 찾아 떠난 예금자도 있었지만 금고는 안전했습니다.
success_text_en: Some depositors left for higher rates, but the vault stayed safe.

label: 장로 자리를 줍니다
success_text_en: The golden altar lit the temple dazzlingly.
fail_text: 그는 장로가 되자 교리에 장사를 섞었습니다.
fail_text_en: As elder he mixed commerce into doctrine.

label: 제단만 감사히 받습니다
label_en: Accept only the altar with thanks
success_text_en: Disappointed, he still gave the altar.
fail_text: 그는 화를 내며 제단을 도로 가져갔습니다.
fail_text_en: He angrily took the altar back.

label: 값을 올려 크게 법니다
success_text_en: The world praised your business acumen.
fail_text_en: Starving crowds raided the granary.

label: 적정 가격에 풉니다
success_text_en: Merchants sneered, but common folk blessed you.

label: 비싼 수업료를 받고 가르칩니다
label_en: Teach them for a hefty fee
success_text_en: The students spread your name back home.
fail_text: 그들은 비결만 훔쳐 경쟁 신전을 세웠습니다.
fail_text_en: They stole the secrets and built a rival temple.

label: 무료로 가르칩니다
success_text: 세상은 비결을 공짜로 넘긴 신전을 비웃었지만, 유학생들은 깊이 감사했습니다.
success_text_en: The world mocked the temple for giving its secrets away, but the students were deeply grateful.

label: 그들도 식탁에 앉힙니다
label_en: Seat them at the table too
success_text: 새 얼굴들이 배를 채우고 신도가 되었습니다.
success_text_en: The newcomers ate their fill and joined the cult.

label: 잔치는 신도만의 것이라 돌려보냅니다
label_en: Turn them away; the feast is for followers
success_text_en: Followers felt proud to be the chosen few.
fail_text_en: Those turned away cursed the cult.

label: 아낌없이 허락합니다
success_text: 대연회는 왕국 역사에 남을 축제가 되었습니다.
success_text_en: The banquet became a festival for the history books.
fail_text_en: Food poisoning turned the feast into chaos.

label: 반만 준비하게 합니다
success_text_en: A smaller but delicious feast.

label: 더 먹게 합니다, 그것이 축복입니다
label_en: Let them eat more; it is a blessing
success_text_en: They were happy, though some fell ill.

label: 식후 춤 의식을 만듭니다
success_text: 배부른 춤이 교단의 새 전통이 되었습니다.
success_text_en: The full-bellied dance became a new tradition.
fail_text_en: Followers grumbled that eating time was cut.

label: 음식으로 그들을 매수합니다
success_text: 산적들은 배를 채우고 교단의 문지기가 되었습니다.
success_text_en: Fed, the bandits became the cult's gatekeepers.
fail_text: 그들은 받은 뒤 더 많이 요구했습니다.
fail_text_en: They took it and demanded more.

label: 무장한 신도로 쫓아냅니다
label_en: Drive them off with armed followers
success_text_en: The bandits fled.
fail_text_en: Followers were hurt in the fight.

label: 그를 초대해 최고의 만찬을 대접합니다
label_en: Invite him to a supreme dinner
success_text: 그는 다음 글에서 당신의 식탁을 극찬했습니다.
success_text_en: His next review raved about your table.
fail_text_en: He wrote an even harsher review.

label: 비웃고 넘깁니다
success_text_en: Followers laughed that fullness beats flavor.

label: 가장 큰 도시로 보냅니다
label_en: Send it to the largest city
success_text: 큰 도시가 당신을 어머니라 부르기 시작했습니다.
success_text_en: The great city began to call you mother.

label: 셋으로 나눠 보냅니다
success_text: 부족했지만 세 곳 모두 고비를 넘겼습니다.
success_text_en: It was not enough, yet all three survived.
fail_text: 너무 적게 나눠 아무 데도 구하지 못했습니다.
fail_text_en: Spread so thin, it saved no one.

label: 원래 신도에게 더 큰 몫을 줍니다
label_en: Give longtime followers a bigger share
success_text_en: Followers were satisfied; newcomers felt slighted.

label: 새 밭을 일궈 모두의 몫을 늘립니다
label_en: Clear new fields to grow everyone's share
success_text: 함께 일한 밭에서 풍성한 수확이 났습니다.
success_text_en: The shared fields gave a rich harvest.
fail_text_en: Drought withered the new fields.

label: 상인들에게 급식 납품을 맡깁니다
label_en: Contract the merchants to supply the meals
success_text_en: The merchants turned from foes to partners.
fail_text_en: They jacked up the supply prices absurdly.

label: 군중을 모아 상인들에게 맞섭니다
label_en: Rally the crowd against the merchants
success_text_en: The roar of the hungry crowd made them back off.
fail_text_en: It turned into a riot and the temple was blamed.

label: 감사히 받습니다
success_text_en: Grain began to grow on the new land.

label: 땅은 돌려주고 신도로 맞습니다
label_en: Return the land and welcome her as a follower
success_text: 세상은 땅을 돌려준 신전을 어리석다 했지만, 그녀의 이야기는 신도들 사이에 퍼졌습니다.
success_text_en: The world called returning the land foolish, but her story spread among your followers.

label: 모두 받아먹습니다
success_text_en: Followers cheered that Mother had embraced the earth.
fail_text_en: You ended up sick in bed.

label: 한 입씩만 먹고 나눠 줍니다
label_en: Take a bite each and share the rest
success_text_en: The rest became a feast for all.

label: 성대한 대관식을 엽니다
success_text_en: All bowed before you.
fail_text: 옛 왕의 지지자들이 대관식장에서 난동을 부렸습니다.
fail_text_en: The old king's loyalists rioted at the ceremony.

label: 옛 왕을 명예 고문으로 앉힙니다
label_en: Make the old king an honorary advisor
success_text: 옛 왕의 지지자들도 당신을 따르게 되었습니다.
success_text_en: Even the old king's loyalists came to follow you.
fail_text_en: He began plotting behind your back.

label: 영지를 하사합니다
success_text_en: You gained a loyal lord.

label: 당신이 직접 다스립니다
success_text_en: The realm's lands gathered in your hands.
fail_text_en: The furious general deserted with his troops.

label: 세금을 올려 군대를 늘립니다
label_en: Raise taxes and expand the army
success_text: 더 강해진 군대 앞에 불만이 잠잠해졌습니다.
success_text_en: Complaints went silent before a stronger army.
fail_text: 반란이 일어나 지방 한 곳을 잃었습니다.
fail_text_en: A revolt cost you a province.

label: 한 해 세금을 면제합니다
success_text_en: The people praised you, though the court grew uneasy.

label: 선제공격합니다
success_text: 동맹은 무너졌고 당신의 이름이 대륙에 울렸습니다.
success_text_en: The alliance crumbled and your name rang across the continent.
fail_text_en: A crushing defeat cost many followers.

label: 한 나라와 비밀 혼약을 맺어 동맹을 깹니다
label_en: Break the alliance with a secret marriage pact
success_text_en: One ally turned to your side.
fail_text_en: The pact leaked and you became a laughingstock.

label: 국경 요새만 강화합니다
success_text: 왕국은 버텼지만 사람들은 당신이 약해졌다고 했습니다.
success_text_en: The kingdom held, but people said you had softened.

label: 본보기로 숙청합니다
success_text_en: The court fell silent in fear.

label: 그를 더 높은 자리에 올려 감시합니다
success_text_en: Overwhelmed, he became a loyal servant.
fail_text: 그는 그 자리를 발판 삼아 세력을 모았습니다.
fail_text_en: He used the post to gather his own faction.

label: 욕망을 거스르는 자를 벌하는 법을 넣습니다
label_en: Add a law punishing those who deny desire
success_text_en: The code declared desire a sacred duty.
fail_text_en: The harsh law turned the people away.

label: 처벌 없이 권장만 합니다
success_text: 야심가들은 미지근한 법이라 비웃었지만 신도들은 안도했습니다.
success_text_en: The ambitious sneered at such a lukewarm law, but your followers were relieved.

label: 사제단을 보내 개종시킵니다
success_text_en: The village raised the cult's banner again.
fail_text_en: The priests were driven out in shame.

label: 마을에 자치를 허락합니다
success_text_en: The world laughed at your weakness, but the village grew quiet.

label: 공개 토론으로 정합니다
success_text_en: The debate sharpened the doctrine.
fail_text: 패자 쪽 파벌이 교단을 둘로 갈랐습니다.
fail_text_en: The loser's faction split the cult.

label: 둘에게 권력을 나눠 줍니다
success_text_en: They worked while checking each other.

label: 조건을 받아들입니다
success_text_en: The cult's banner rose over another kingdom.

label: 임명권은 넘기지 않겠다고 버팁니다
success_text_en: The king eventually accepted your terms.
fail_text_en: Insulted, the king withdrew his invitation.

label: 당신이 직접 하루 종일 판결합니다
success_text_en: Your swift judgments were praised.
fail_text_en: You collapsed from overwork amid rumors of wrong verdicts.

label: 하급 사제들에게 재판권을 나눕니다
success_text_en: Trials sped up but left your hands.
